purpose: Expand the source-only right-ECDF gauge validated on the opened Lego development sentinel to the frozen SPIn9 cohort without scene tuning or representation mixing.

claim_boundary.lego: previously opened development sentinel; its immutable receipt is retained but it is not an unbiased confirmation scene
claim_boundary.remaining_eight: no new target prediction, target mask, or target metric may be opened until every source authority gate passes and the cohort receipt index is sealed
claim_boundary.full9: diagnostic full-reference-mask protocol, not directly comparable to the published sparse-point interaction protocol

frozen_protocol.aggregation: per-frame foreground IoU, per-scene unweighted mean, then unweighted macro over nine scenes
frozen_protocol.resize: bilinear continuous margin to frozen target shape, then greater-or-equal zero
frozen_protocol.target_mask_use: scoring only after cohort receipt gate

uniform_representation_contract.capability_projection: factorized raw RADIO field then frozen official DINOv3/SAM3 adaptors
uniform_representation_contract.surface_graph: surface-safe mutual-K16 with exact official capability affinity, local tangent relation, and source co-visibility
uniform_representation_contract.matched_interface: exact Euclidean K201 including self plus fixed 256-dimensional signed hash of official DINO capability
uniform_representation_contract.historical_compact_assets: rebuild inputs and historical context only

per_scene_source_authority_gate: frozen carrier and camera mapping are present and geometry-consistent
factorized raw observation cache is sealed with the feature bundle, geometry checkpoint, and source responsibility SHA-256 values
factorized field passes the same source reconstruction and capability fidelity gates used for Lego
materialized official capability cache passes strict lineage and fp16 parity
surface-safe graph, K201 neighbor cache, and relation cache share exact primitive row authority
native exact reference responsibility W is exported and sealed
full-fit source support score and source-weighted ECDF gauge are sealed
continuous target margins and per-frame hashes are sealed in a pre-metric receipt

source_quantile_gauge.fit_scope: separately for each scene using only its complete invariant source reference
source_quantile_gauge.population: factorized matched-K201 primitive rows whose exact source reference responsibility weight is positive

prediction_contract.source_visibility: same query-independent source-visible definition and alpha-normalized scalar Gaussian compositor as Lego v2
prediction_contract.coverage_projection: require finite FP32 values within [-16 eps,1+16 eps], fail outside, otherwise project to [0,1]

cohort_receipt_gate.remaining_receipts: all eight must exist, pass hash/lineage checks, and be indexed together before any new target mask access
cohort_receipt_gate.receipt_failure: fail closed without opening any remaining target mask

execution_order.priority: estimated fixed source-authority cost, smallest first, without sharing a GPU with an active job
stage_order_per_scene: source feature bundle seal and exact SHA bindings
matched K201 relation and neighbor caches
execution_order.stage_failure: stop the scene before downstream work
execution_order.target_evaluation: deferred until the cohort receipt gate passes

thermal_and_concurrency_policy.polling: stage boundaries plus approximately every 180 seconds for stages longer than six minutes
thermal_and_concurrency_policy.stop_rule: stop only after two consecutive observations at or above 88 C or any Xid/ECC/driver error
thermal_and_concurrency_policy.short_stage_rule: do not interrupt or poll repeatedly merely because a sub-six-minute stage is busy

stop_rules: Fail closed on any missing or mismatched source authority, primitive row set, geometry fingerprint, or SHA-256.
Do not silently use an NVOS scene asset for the same-named SPIn scene.
Do not change q=0.96, raw seen threshold 0.71, right-ECDF ties, exact weights, K=201, coverage rule, interpolation, or comparison after registration.
Do not use historical target scores, target masks, target metrics, or per-scene oracle thresholds to rebuild or calibrate a scene.
Do not open any new non-Lego target mask until the full cohort receipt index is sealed.
